profileId.description: Wise profile ID that owns the quote and transfer.

sourceAmount.description: Amount in sourceCurrency. Provide either sourceAmount or targetAmount.

targetAmount.description: Amount in targetCurrency. Provide either sourceAmount or targetAmount.

recipientId.description: Existing recipient account ID. If omitted, recipient fields are used to create one.

recipient.description: Flat recipient fields matching create_recipient_simple when recipientId is omitted.

reference.description: Payment reference shown to the recipient where supported.

payOut.description: Wise payout method. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER when omitted.
